LIHUOWANG2_KEYWORD_FORESEE.title: Foresee
LIHUOWANG2_KEYWORD_FORESEE.description:
Look at the top cards of your draw pile.
You may discard any number of them.
LIHUOWANG2_KEYWORD_DURABILITY.title: Durability
LIHUOWANG2_KEYWORD_DURABILITY.descriptio:
A Durability card loses 1 Durability each time it is played.
When it reaches 0, the card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold]; otherwise it is discarded as usual.
On the card text, "Durability (X/Y)" shows X as remaining uses and Y as total uses.
